newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Aida posts yr loss, appoints Lew Geffen md.
newsitem.headline: Aida posts yr loss, appoints Lew Geffen md.

text.p: South African property group Aida Holdings Ltd (Aida) announced on Thursday it had chalked up a loss of 1.8 million rand for the year to February 28, up from the previous year's loss of 800,000 rand.
The company said in a statement it had appointed real estate businessman Lew Geffen managing director, replacing Aida Geffen, Aida founder and Lew Geffen's mother.

Aida said Lew Geffen's 85 cent-a-share offer for 51 percent of Aida had lapsed but fresh negotiations were underway between the Aida Family Trust, Aida Geffen and Lew Geffen to enable the purchase of a controlling interest.
"It is intended by the Aida Trust (and) Mrs Aida Geffen that I shall be granted an option to acquire a controlling interest in the company," Lew Geffen said in a statement.
Aida had been restructured into a dedicated franchise operation which bodes well for future profits, the company said.
The company said the Geffens planned to use about 5.5 million unissued shares to structure a group benefit scheme.
A company spokesman said further details of Aida's financial results would be released on Friday.
